memo.army.dev

Acknowledgements

memo.army.dev is free software, and it ships alongside free software: the delivered bundle redistributes the components below, including every Rust crate compiled into its two WebAssembly binaries. Each entry lists the version actually shipped, its copyright holders or authors, and its license; the full text of every referenced license appears once in the license texts section. URLs on this page are plain references — the app itself never talks to any server beyond the one hosting it.

Components

memo.army.dev 0.1.0

Copyright (C) John E. Rollinson (jrolli) and the memo.army.dev contributors

The application itself — the page markup, styles, and compiled TypeScript delivered in the bundle. Source: github.com/jrolli/armymemo-maker. License: AGPL-3.0-or-later.

typst.ts 0.7.0

Copyright 2023-2025 Myriad-Dreamin

The @myriaddreamin/typst.ts JavaScript runtime and the @myriaddreamin/typst-ts-web-compiler WASM binary (the in-browser Typst compiler). Source: github.com/Myriad-Dreamin/typst.ts. License: Apache-2.0.

eform 0.4.0 (commit a7db0d43e66e0162cf0b5ffd5ae05140133b0fc6)

Copyright (C) John E. Rollinson (jrolli)

The eform WASM module (formerly esign) that places PDF form fields — signature, text, and checkbox (vendor/eform/). Source: github.com/jrolli/eform. License: AGPL-3.0-or-later.

armymemo 0.2.3

Copyright (C) the armymemo authors (jschless, jrolli)

AR 25-50 Army memorandum template for Typst, vendored as vendor/armymemo-0.2.3.tar.gz (its LICENSE ships inside the tarball). Source: github.com/jrolli/armymemo. License: AGPL-3.0-or-later.

yaml 2.9.0

Copyright Eemeli Aro <eemeli@gmail.com>

YAML parser used to read the front matter of Markdown memos on the conversion page. Source: github.com/eemeli/yaml. License: ISC.

commonmark.js 0.31.2

Copyright (c) 2014, John MacFarlane

CommonMark reference parser used to convert Markdown memo bodies to Typst on the conversion page. Source: github.com/commonmark/commonmark.js. License: BSD-2-Clause.

entities 3.0.1

Copyright (c) Felix Böhm

HTML entity decoder bundled as a dependency of commonmark.js. Source: github.com/fb55/entities. License: BSD-2-Clause.

mdurl 1.0.1

Copyright (c) 2015 Vitaly Puzrin, Alex Kocharin.

URL encoder bundled as a dependency of commonmark.js. Source: github.com/markdown-it/mdurl. License: MIT.
